target_customer: Data teams and analysts writing SQL (B2B)
problem: Writing SQL and analyzing data is slow and costly; generative AI could write it faster.

founders.name: Andrew Duberstein
founders.background_notes: Built pydeck at Uber (12M+ downloads); later a data scientist at OpenAI per a secondary source.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM-based text-to-SQL with retrieval; the team published a benchmark-leading paper (Dubo-SQL, BIRD-SQL), showing real research depth.

defensibility.rationale: Text-to-SQL is a feature that data-platform vendors and many startups could add.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated incumbent action found in sources.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand was found in sources; the premise was that generative AI could cut the cost of writing SQL, and the founders came from Instacart data science and Uber.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage; company name Mercator (geo-map origin) was kept while the product moved to Dubo, and Mercator is also the name of unrelated companies; the dubo.gg domain now redirects elsewhere.

pivots.from: Dubo natural-language analysis plus Geofencer map annotation tool
pivots.why: Not stated; announced as a full pivot per a third-party archive.

outcome_analysis: Mercator joined YC in S22 with two founders, built Dubo and published a record-setting Dubo-SQL paper, and pivoted to an SQL editor in March 2024. YC lists it as Inactive and a co-founder's profile describes it in the past tense, but no shutdown announcement, funding amount or cause is public, so the cause of the failure is not public.
notes: No funding amounts found; YC page lists backers (Tribe Capital, Soma Capital, Valor Equity Partners, Amplify Partners, Rebel Fund) without amounts, so no rounds recorded. Exit type unknown: directory status Inactive but no shutdown evidence; Duberstein's profile names OpenAI and one secondary source says Thorpe started VarietyIQ (not independently verified). Dubo product launch date 2024-03-27 from Product Hunt. Founder surname Duberstein from secondary sources; YC page shows only first name.
